hebrewText: הֵ֤מָּה יֹאבֵדוּ֮ וְ/אַתָּ֪ה תַ֫עֲמֹ֥ד וְ֭/כֻלָּ/ם כַּ/בֶּ֣גֶד יִבְל֑וּ כַּ/לְּב֖וּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵ֣/ם וְֽ/יַחֲלֹֽפוּ

tokens.kjv: it, like, [idiom] (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, [idiom] so, [idiom] such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.

tokens.bdb: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
tokens.kjv: break, destroy(-uction), [phrase] not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, [idiom] and surely, take, be undone, [idiom] utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.

tokens.bdb: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
to stand, in various relations (literal and figurative, intransitive and transitive)
tokens.kjv: abide (behind), appoint, arise, cease, confirm, continue, dwell, be employed, endure, establish, leave, make, ordain, be (over), place, (be) present (self), raise up, remain, repair, [phrase] serve, set (forth, over, -tle, up), (make to, make to be at a, with-) stand (by, fast, firm, still, up), (be at a) stay (up), tarry.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: a covering, i.e. clothing; also treachery or pillage
tokens.kjv: apparel, cloth(-es, ing), garment, lap, rag, raiment, robe, [idiom] very (treacherously), vesture, wardrobe.

tokens.bdb: to fail; by implication to wear out, decay (causatively, consume, spend)
tokens.kjv: consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to fail; by implication to wear out
tokens.enLiteralWord: to fail; by implication to wear out
tokens.explanation: to fail; by implication to wear out
tokens.explanationEn: to fail; by implication to wear out

tokens.bdb: a garment (literally or figuratively); by implication (euphemistically) a wife
tokens.kjv: apparel, clothed with, clothing, garment, raiment, vestment, vesture.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.enLiteralWord: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.explanation: a garment ; by implication  a wife
tokens.explanationEn: a garment ; by implication  a wife

tokens.bdb: properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change
tokens.kjv: abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through.
